lesson: The corrected capability input allowed Spot but the GPT-selected fresh structure omitted Spot and Beagle. It repaired M55's Melantha/#9 chain but reintroduced an early artillery-medical failure: Ansel died on the second 891 shell, then Steward died after three 910 shells. The eastern/inner collapse produced the first leak and 13 dependent errors, while late roadblock clearance and #34 interception were not operationally sufficient.
revision_requirements: Separate or reposition the early artillery lock target so the first two shell waves cannot chain-kill the main medical line.
Provide output and medical handoff during Spot-like heal pauses if that fusion is selected; Spot itself was not selected this run.
Ensure the eastern/inner route has live blocking and killing through #20/#21/#22 without waiting for late roadblock damage.
Kill or reliably intercept artillery before it can leak or kill protected targets.
Intercept and damage #34; zero DAMAGE/BLOCK cannot close the duty.
